integrity: Every morphism that can beat or tie the claimed minima is exhaustively enumerated. Thue-Morse factor membership is tested using the published exact finite-factor bound and cross-checked against an independent parity-of-binary-digit-sums generator. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact minima and minimizers are proved only for the three generating atypical words aabab, abaaba, and aabbaab. No formula for every atypical factor is claimed, and originality searches cannot exclude an unindexed computation or unpublished observation.
title: Shortest atypicality witnesses for the three generating Thue–Morse atypical words
